reviews.review:
I originally played this game the week it came out but one thing made me mad more than anything else and that was the horrible checkpoints in the game. The dev did make it a bit better with updates but its still not the best as if you die in the one area where you get in the back of a truck mowing dudes down with a machine gun you get sent back into the facility all the way to the beginning (its still like this in October 2025 btw). Holy ♥♥♥♥ dev please playtest your game before you release it. I raged quit the game that August then came back in October to beat it lol. 

Only reason I didn't abandon the game entirely was that it was interesting and was nicely designed beyond that. Definitely a somewhat middle tier of indie game quality as some areas were lacking in detail and plain but there was some effort put into the game. This game isn't that bad beyond the horrible checkpoints but at the same time I wouldn't expect very high quality of it if you do buy it. I did like the voice acting in the game but other than that please playtest your game and add good checkpoints if you do make future games
